title: fix: correct subuid and subgid name flag mappings
body:
The --subgidname flag was incorrectly populating cf.SubUIDName and the --subuidname flag was incorrectly populating cf.SubGIDName. This fix swaps the destination fields to their correct mappings:
- --subgidname now populates cf.SubGIDName
- --subuidname now populates cf.SubUIDName

Also adds a regression test to verify both mappings independently and prevent this bug from returning.

Fixes #29885
